name: Fujoshi ja nai Mon!
source:
Kana is a beautiful girl and the head of the book club.
She's been trying to write a short novel.
Her club consists of four members.
The other members are boys.

In the name of club activities those boys achieve nothing but idiocy!
Every day Kana is angered into rock-scissors-paper to get started.

"The theme is 'love' and I want you to help write it!"

Exasperated and hoping to inspire their efforts, she has an idea.
She allows herself to be seized by the boys as an example.
Could these scenarios possibly be love?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ063682.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
Kana是个漂亮的女孩，也是读书社社长。
她一直在尝试写一篇短篇小说。
社团一共有四名成员，
其他三人全是男生。

这群男生打着社团活动的旗号，做的却尽是蠢事！
每天都得让Kana气得拉他们猜拳，才能开始活动。

“主题是‘爱情’，我想请你们帮忙一起写！”

又气又急的她，为了激发大家的创作热情，想到了一个主意。
她让男生们抓住自己，亲自做示范。
这样的场景，也能算是爱情吗？

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ063682.html/]DLsite英文版[/url]]
